name: Howling Vale
summary: In north-central Ashenvale, Terrowulf worgen howl through Howling Vale near the Felwood border. Their caves conceal an ancient shrine to Elune, bound to the worgen’s origins on Kalimdor.

sections.title: A Haunted Haven
sections.body: North of the road to Felwood, the Terrowulf’s howls break Ashenvale’s calm. Ancient trees fill the vale, but corrupted packlords and aggressive wildlife roam beneath them. At its heart, a cave holds the ruined shrine of Mel'Thandris, an ancient night elf priestess. Once devoted to quiet worship, the shrine is now defiled by feral wolf-men. The nearby Sentinels cannot explain where they came from.

sections.title: The Scythe and the Starsong Legacy
sections.body: The Tome of Mel'Thandris tells what happened at the shrine. Night elf Velinde Starsong came into possession of the Scythe of Elune, a fateful artifact. She sought to channel its power against demons, but instead unleashed the worgen in the surrounding woods. Now the beasts she summoned haunt the vale.

faq.q: Why is it called the Howling Vale?
faq.answer: The Terrowulf worgen gave the vale its grim name with their chilling calls. Their howls echo through canyon and cavern, drowning out Ashenvale’s natural sounds.

faq.q: What is the Shrine of Mel'Thandris?
faq.answer: The Shrine of Mel'Thandris is an ancient night elf sanctuary dedicated to Elune and named for Mel'Thandris. The Tome of Mel'Thandris, kept there, records events that may explain the wolf-men’s arrival.

faq.q: Where did the worgen here come from?
aliases: how did worgen get to ashenvale
faq.answer: The Sentinels are puzzled by the worgen’s origin. Sentinel Melyria Frostshadow sends Alliance scouts to study the Tome of Mel'Thandris at the shrine, whose history holds the key to the wolf-men’s origins.

faq.q: What is the Tome of Mel'Thandris?
faq.answer: The Tome of Mel'Thandris is a sacred historical text kept at the shrine deep inside the cave. Sentinel Melyria Frostshadow sends Alliance scouts to study it and learn where the wolf-men plaguing the forest came from.

angles.text: For the kaldorei, the defilement of Mel'Thandris’s shrine is a bitter wound. A sacred place of Elune now lies overrun by savage wolf-men.
The feral wolf-men in the cave are a dark mirror of druidic shapeshifting. Their arrival in Ashenvale remains a mystery to the Sentinels.
